task.title: P6-065: Clean up e2e data hygiene in one commit
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 9 — Dev loop, tests and test strength). Original id: P6-065. Size: S. Specs: specs/ui-work-loop.md.

**E2E data hygiene, one commit** (absorbs `P6-075`, `P6-052` and `P6-009g`). A `globalTeardown` sweeping `zz-e2e-*` — `playwright.config.ts` has none, and a timed-out test leaks its scratch collection because the `request` fixture is torn down before the `finally` runs (documented as acceptable in `collection-tree-manage.spec.ts:19`, now also reachable from `collection-view.spec.ts`); duplicate names then make by-name locators ambiguous on the next run. Only `batch-move.spec.ts:74-76` uses random-suffixed names; five other specs use worker+seq only. Plus: `destination-picker.spec.ts:187-209`'s "+ Want" test grows real Inbox Lightning Bolt desires with no undo or cleanup — that is the mechanism behind the accumulated pile dominating `/my/shopping` — so scope quick-add tests' wants so it stops growing, and clean up what is there (**the "88 desires" figure is unverified; check by loading `/my/shopping` or querying the dev branch**). `cleanup-mutation-leftovers.mjs` exists, is unregistered, and cleans holdings only, not desires. One orphaned `zz-e2e-inb-src-w1-9` collection matches no current spec's prefix.
